# AB Trader

> AB Trader is a livestock and dairy feed raw material supplier based in Bhains Colony, Road No. 6, Karachi, Pakistan. We supply cattle and dairy farmers all over Pakistan, with export supply available. Feed Ingredients & Agricultural Commodities Trading.

Contact: WhatsApp +92 314 3942492 · info@abtrader.pk · https://abtrader.pk

## Pages
- [Home](https://abtrader.pk/): who we are, order in 3 steps, services
- [Products](https://abtrader.pk/products): full catalogue of 35 feed products in 6 groups, with an order list that is sent on WhatsApp
- [Feed Balancing](https://abtrader.pk/balancing): free ration calculator for cows and buffaloes (energy, protein, fibre, cost, cheapest mix)
- [Lab Reports](https://abtrader.pk/lab-reports): tested protein, fat, fibre and moisture of our feed
- [Formulas](https://abtrader.pk/formulas): ready ration plans for milking cows and buffaloes

## What we supply
- Grains & raw materials: wheat (gandum), cracked wheat, maize (makai), cracked maize, ground maize, mung (mongi), red lentils (masoor)
- By-products & choras: wheat bran (chokar), black gram husk (kala chora), macaroni & vermicelli, chickpea flour, broken pulses (mash, moth, masoor, mong kutta)
- Pala & feed: NDF Pala, HDF Pala, SA Pala, Fazlani Atti, Master Feed, Nagori Feed
- Protein meals & oil cakes: soybean meal and hulls, canola meal, mustard meal and oil cake (sarso khal), pea flour and hulls
- Supplements & additives: maize gluten 30%, toxin binder, yeast, DCP
- Cow mats (rubber dairy cow mats), sold per piece

## Selling units
Most items are sold per kg. Chokar is sold per 34 kg bag, NDF and HDF Pala per 48 kg bag, SA Pala and Fazlani Atti per 40 kg bag. Cow mats are sold per piece. Rates change daily: ask on WhatsApp.

## Languages
English, Urdu (اردو) and Roman Urdu.
